next.connectors.title: Mail, calendars, feeds
next.connectors.foot: Passwords and tokens are kept in this machine's safe and never come back to the page. Agents read on their own; they send a letter or a message in your name only after your yes in the chat.
next.connectors.disconnectSure: Disconnect “{name}”? Agents stop reading it, and its saved password leaves the safe.
next.connectors.ask.aria: An agent asks to confirm a send
next.connectors.ask.lead: The agent asks to send in your name
next.connectors.ask.trust: Send to {who} without asking from now on
next.connectors.reissueSure: Reissue the secret of “{name}”? The old one stops working at once; give the service the new one.
next.connectors.shownLead: Save it now: it is not shown again. The secret is kept in this machine's safe.
next.connectors.rulesLead: What to do with events. The agent only proposes: a letter or a message goes after your «OK» on the card.
next.connectors.push.title: Turn on notifications on this device
next.connectors.push.lead: To confirm sends from your phone and know when an agent is done
next.connectors.push.forSend: The agent waits for your yes — with notifications on, it reaches your phone
next.connectors.push.install: On iPhone notifications work in the installed app: Share → Add to Home Screen, then open it from there.
next.connectors.push.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site: allow them in the browser's site settings, then reload.
next.connectors.push.deniedApple: Notifications are blocked: Settings → Notifications → harnessly, allow them.
next.connectors.push.failed: Could not turn them on: try again in a moment
